payload.goal: Implement only packages/core/src/photo-edit-policy.ts for the existing independent test. Export validatePhotoEditPlan and provider-neutral plan types. Accept only exposure, contrast, saturation, tone_curve, local_light and white_balance as ordinary pixel adjustments with finite numeric amounts when present. Reject appearance-changing or unknown operations. Allow crop only when compositionChangeApproved is exactly true. Require preserveOriginal true, distinct non-empty source/output asset IDs, positive integer dimensions and output resolution equal to source resolution. Return a validated copy without mutating input. Do not edit tests or any other file.
